item.title: Do you like vignettes that constantly darken the edges of the screen in a game
item.author: invalid@example.com (flyinj)
item.dc:creator: flyinj
item.content:encoded: Seeing how we probably have the most people in the world being exposed to 1/4 of their screen edge being darkened by a vignette in the game they are playing right now, I'd really like to know if anyone actually likes this. This isn't about temporary red "injured" vignettes, or "shellshocked" vignettes. This is about the "artistic choice" to constantly darken the edges of the screen. I'm going to guess this poll is going to be 85-95% no. Why do developers still do this when everyone hates it

item.title: GTAVI - turning down analog stick dead zone is so much better for aiming…
item.author: invalid@example.com (lowhighkang_LHK)
item.dc:creator: lowhighkang_LHK
item.content:encoded: I was wondering why I had to move the right analog stick so much to get the aim reticule to move. Under controller settings the analog dead zone value is at 4 and maxed out lol I dropped it to 2 for both Left stick and right stick deadzone setting and it feels so much better. To the point where I felt i needed to make a new thread for it. The shooting went from being hey it's okay to wow this feels kinda…good?

item.content:encoded: One thing I try to do is not to play games from the same genre back to back. I'm lucky that I have a lot of genres I do like. I am not a genre specialist. I remember playing DQ1 and 2 HD2D back to back. And while fun, it was a bit too much. I should have taken a break in between them.
